chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from one of his companions, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'From the respecting of Allah is the respecting the Muslim with old age.'

key_terms.إِجْلَالُ: Respect, veneration, or honoring with reverence
key_terms.ذِي الشَّيْبَةِ: The one with white hair, referring to the elderly

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual significance of respecting the elderly in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi by Shaykh al-Kulayni, this hadith links the social virtue of respecting the elderly (izi al-shaybati) directly to the theological concept of honoring Allah, elevating it from mere etiquette to an act of worship. In Shia scholarship, this is often contextualized within the broader framework of 'Ijmal al-Din' (comprehensive religion), where social hierarchy and age are seen as signs of Allah's wisdom, making their respect a tangible reflection of divine glory.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from one of his companions, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘From the respecting of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> is the respecting the Muslims with old age’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from certain individuals of his people from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “
The Messenger of Allah has said, ‘Of high regard toward Allah, is having high regard for a Muslim who has grown a beard.’”
